designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1936 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as wintering habitat for waterfowl in the Mississippi Delta.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Yazoo National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Mar. 21, 2006 (06-2673), Theodore Roosevelt NWR Complex CCP: "Yazoo National Wildlife Refuge (established in 1936)"

review.note: Draft date 1929 is the year of the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, not the refuge. Yazoo NWR dates to 1936.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Yazoo National Wildlife Refuge was established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act (1929) and the Migratory Bird Treaty Act (1918).
